evidence.quote: The current study utilised samples from 39 women in the original cohort.
Extracted DNA was amplified using the PacBio uni-tagged 27F/1492R primers
Of the three DNA extraction controls included, two produced reads ( Table 1 ); both PCR controls produced no reads.
no computational removal of potential contaminant sequences was performed

notes: 31 amniotic fluid samples analysed (11 preterm, 20 term). Control OTUs listed in Table 1; no computational removal, but dominant Novosphingobium/Sphingomonas interpreted as extraction-kit contaminants (remain in profile; shown removed in Fig 4 only). Authors: bacterial DNA unlikely from controls in 20/31 samples, but viability uncertain; profiles not predictive of PTB. Genera Lactobacillus, Ralstonia, Acidovorax named from own data in Discussion.
